nl: Vue2 经销商维护，单文件组件模式：表格展示经销商名称、联系人、电话、合作状态（合作中/已停止）；支持新增、编辑、删除，不需要查询条件。后端返回 { data: [...], total: N }。
nlEn: Vue2 dealer maintenance in single-file-component mode: the table shows dealer name, contact, phone, and cooperation status (active/stopped); supports add, edit, and delete, with no query fields. The backend returns { data: [...], total: N }.
notes: AI-08: { data, total } mapping in SFC mode — covers the SFC options emit (vue2/sfc)
